title: Grouped dwellings on the same lot apply C3.10.1 to C3.10.3 to each other
text: Sources of overlooking for grouped dwellings on the same lot are to apply C3.10.1, C3.10.2 and C3.10.3.

replaces.note: register row ch3-088 maps C3.10.2-C3.10.6 to Part C C3.10.2-C3.10.6 as 'same measures'; clause-level match not checked

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: New to the grouped package (no Chapter 2 twin; Chapter 2 C3.10.4 is the vacant-site rule, Chapter 3 C3.10.5). Cross-reference clause: C3.10.1, C3.10.2 and C3.10.3 apply between dwellings on the same lot. The privacy facts describe one adjoining interface, so the engine cannot run the rules per internal pair; a planner checks the internal cones. Recorded as judgment.
